newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-SPARTAK STILL LEAD DESPITE DEFEAT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SPARTAK STILL LEAD DESPITE DEFEAT.

text.p: Russian champions Spartak Moscow maintained the lead in the premier league despite losing 1-0 at home to cross-town rivals Torpedo LM on Wednesday.
Dynamo Moscow beat lowly Krylya Sovietov Samara 1-0 to close to one point behind the leaders and level on 40 points with Rotor Volgograd who retained second place on goal difference.
Mid-table Rostselmash Rostov cruised past railway club Lokomotiv Nizhny Novgorod 3-1 in a home game.
All 18 premier league clubs have played 21 games. The three matches played on Wednesday were delayed from last month because of the InterToto championship.
